blocks.content: Course: CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
When you start building layouts, these default styles cause confusion:

items: "Why does this look different in another browser?"

blocks.content: I'm fighting the browser instead of styling my page.
So the first step is simple:
Let's do an observation task (Very Important, No Code Yet)

items: Open your blog without writing any CSS

Look carefully at:
		Space around headingsIndentation of listsDefault font sizes
Ask yourself: "Did I add this styling?"

blocks.content: If the answer is no — that's the browser.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
